title: IREL Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 39 Apprentice Posts
description: Indian Rare Earths Limited (IREL) has announced the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 39 Graduate Apprentice, Technician Apprentice, and Trade Apprentice Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, ITI, or Diploma can use this opportunity and apply for the IREL Notification 2026 . Here, we have included more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how ...
